                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 0%;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(12px, 2vw, 24px);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            transform: scale(1.4);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.5);
        }

        .nav-dot:hover { background: var(--accent-teal); transform: scale(1.2); }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE-SPECIFIC: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(247, 127, 0, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            line-height: 1.15;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: min(75vw, 650px);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 2rem);
        }

        .title-slide .source-tag {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .title-slide .source-tag span {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        /* Decorative accent line */
        .title-accent {
            width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 80px);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            margin: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem) auto;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE-SPECIFIC: SECTION HEADER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3.2vw, 2.4rem);
            line-height: 1.2;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(85vw, 800px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PREVALENCE CALLOUTS
           =========================================== */
        .prevalence-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .prevalence-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.1);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .prevalence-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .prevalence-card.women::before { background: var(--accent-coral); }
        .prevalence-card.men::before { background: var(--accent-teal); }

        .prevalence-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            display: block;
        }

        .prevalence-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem);
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .prevalence-card.women .prevalence-number { color: var(--accent-coral); }
        .prevalence-card.men .prevalence-number { color: var(--accent-teal); }

        .prevalence-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .prevalence-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
        }

        .prevalence-note strong { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: HORIZONTAL BAR CHART
           =========================================== */
        .chart-container {
            max-width: min(90vw, 850px);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(90px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(6px, 1.2vh, 14px);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            font-weight: 400;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bar-track {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 4px;
            height: clamp(20px, 3vh, 32px);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill { /* widths set inline */ }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-align: left;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .chart-source {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: DEPRESSION VS ANXIETY PARITY
           =========================================== */
        .parity-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            align-items: stretch;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .parity-card {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.1);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .parity-card.depression { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-teal); }
        .parity-card.anxiety { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-amber); }

        .parity-card .parity-title {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .parity-card .parity-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .parity-card.depression .parity-value { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .parity-card.anxiety .parity-value { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        .parity-card .parity-unit {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .parity-vs {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            min-width: clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
        }

        .parity-note {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .parity-note strong { color: var(--accent-teal); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: SEVERE CONDITIONS
           =========================================== */
        .severity-comparison {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 850px);
            width: 100%;
            align-items: flex-end;
        }

        .severity-col {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .severity-bar-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 120px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .severity-bar {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .severity-bar-inner {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
            transition: height 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: center;
            padding-top: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 8px);
        }

        .severity-bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.9rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .severity-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: clamp(4px, 0.8vh, 10px);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .severity-label strong {
            display: block;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .severity-insight {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-coral);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .severity-insight p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .severity-insight strong { color: var(--accent-coral); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: TREATMENT GAP
           =========================================== */
        .gap-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .gap-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border: 1px solid rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.08);
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .gap-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
            height: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .gap-icon.stigma { background: rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.15); }
        .gap-icon.access { background: rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.15); }
        .gap-icon.quality { background: rgba(247, 127, 0, 0.15); }
        .gap-icon.data { background: rgba(155, 141, 196, 0.15); }

        .gap-text h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.5vh, 6px);
        }

        .gap-text p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .gap-treatable {
            background: rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.2);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .gap-treatable p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: COPING STRATEGIES
           =========================================== */
        .coping-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 850px);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .coping-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.08);
        }

        .coping-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            display: block;
        }

        .coping-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.5vh, 6px);
        }

        .coping-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .coping-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(85vw, 700px);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            list-style: none;
            max-width: min(90vw, 750px);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 1vw, 10px);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .takeaway-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SUBTLE BACKGROUND PATTERNS
           =========================================== */
        .bg-grid {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }

        .bg-gradient-subtle {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           FOOTER / SOURCE TAGS
           =========================================== */
        .slide-footer {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(8px, 1.5vh, 16px);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            right: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .slide-footer .source {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .slide-footer .page-num {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
    </style>

<body>
    <!-- Progress bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- Navigation dots -->
    <nav class="nav-dots" id="navDots"></nav>

    <!-- ========== SLIDE 1: TITLE ========== -->
    <section class="slide title-slide" id="slide-0">
        <div class="slide-content" style="align-items: center; text-align: center;">
            <h1 class="reveal">The Global Burden<br>of Mental Illness</h1>
            <div class="title-accent reveal"></div>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Prevalence, Impact, and the Treatment Gap<br>A data-driven overview of global mental health conditions, 2023</p>
            <p class="source-tag reveal">Source: <span>Our World in Data</span> · IHME Global Burden of Disease (2025)</p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ========== SLIDE 2: PREVALENCE ========== -->
    <section class="slide bg-gradient-subtle" id="slide-1">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-number reveal">02 — Prevalence</div>
            <h2 class="slide-title reveal">Hundreds of Millions Affected</h2>

                <div class="prevalence-card women">
                    <span class="prevalence-icon">♀</span>
                    <div class="prevalence-number">1 in 3</div>

        </div>
        <div class="slide-footer">

            <span class="page-num">2 / 8</span>

    <!-- ========== SLIDE 3: BURDEN BY CATEGORY (BAR CHART) ========== -->
    <section class="slide bg-grid" id="slide-2">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="slide-number reveal">03 — Disease Burden</div>
            <h2 class="slide-title reveal">Depression and Anxiety Dominate the Global Burden</h2>
            <div class="chart-container reveal">
                <div class="bar-row">
                    <span class="bar-label">Depressive disorders</span>
                    <div class="bar-track">
                        <div class="bar-fill" data-width="100%" style="background: var(--accent-teal); width: 0;"></div>

                    <span class="bar-value" style="color: var(--accent-teal);">694.6</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bar-row">
                    <span class="bar-label">Anxiety disorders</span>
                    <div class="bar-track">
                        <div class="bar-fill" data-width="98.8%" style="background: var(--accent-amber); width: 0;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="bar-value" style="color: var(--accent-amber);">686.5</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bar-row">

                    <div class="bar-track">
                        <div class="bar-fill" data-width="30.3%" style="background: var(--accent-coral); width: 0;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="bar-value" style="color: var(--accent-coral);">210.2</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bar-row">
                    <span class="bar-label">Bipolar disorder</span>
                    <div class="bar-track">
                        <div class="bar-fill" data-width="13.6%" style="background: var(--accent-lavender); width: 0;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="bar-value" style="color: var(--accent-lavender);">94.6</span>
                </div>
                <div class="bar-row">
                    <span class="bar-label">Eating disorders</span>
                    <div class="bar-track">

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.animateBars();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.animateBars();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            animateBars() {
                /* Animate horizontal bar chart fills when slide 3 is visible */
                const slide3 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                if (slide3 && slide3.classList.contains('visible')) {
                    slide3.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                        const target = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                        if (target && bar.style.width === '0px' || bar.style.width === '0') {
                            setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = target; }, 200);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INITIALIZE
           =========================================== */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
            const first = document.getElementById('slide-0');
            if (first) first.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.animateBars();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.animateBars();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            animateBars() {
                /* Animate horizontal bar chart fills when slide 3 is visible */
                const slide3 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                if (slide3 && slide3.classList.contains('visible')) {
                    slide3.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                        const target = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                        if (target && bar.style.width === '0px' || bar.style.width === '0') {
                            setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = target; }, 200);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INITIALIZE
           =========================================== */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
            const first = document.getElementById('slide-0');
            if (first) first.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.animateBars();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.animateBars();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = idx;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            animateBars() {
                /* Animate horizontal bar chart fills when slide 3 is visible */
                const slide3 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                if (slide3 && slide3.classList.contains('visible')) {
                    slide3.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill').forEach(bar => {
                        const target = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                        if (target && bar.style.width === '0px' || bar.style.width === '0') {
                            setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = target; }, 200);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           INITIALIZE
           =========================================== */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
            const first = document.getElementById('slide-0');
            if (first) first.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Convert a single-file HTML presentation into a PPTX deck.
3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).
10	
11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""
14	
15	import argparse
16	import os
17	import http.server
18	import subprocess
19	import sys
20	import tempfile
21	import threading
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from PIL import Image
25	from pptx import Presentation
26	from pptx.util import Emu
27	
28	
29	# CSS selectors to count slides, tried in order
30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""
85	
86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs
167	
168	
169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))
189	
190	
191	def main():
192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Mental Health Burden PPTX directly using python-pptx."""

from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

# ── Color Palette ──
BG_DARK      = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)
BG_SURFACE   = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x30, 0x44)
TEXT_WHITE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF1)
TEXT_SECOND   = RGBColor(0x88, 0x99, 0xAA)
TEXT_MUTED    = RGBColor(0x5A, 0x6F, 0x82)
ACCENT_TEAL  = RGBColor(0x48, 0xCA, 0xE4)
ACCENT_AMBER = RGBColor(0xF7, 0x7F, 0x00)
ACCENT_CORAL = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x6F, 0x51)
ACCENT_SAGE  = RGBColor(0x52, 0xB7, 0x88)
ACCENT_LAV   = RGBColor(0x9B, 0x8D, 0xC4)
ACCENT_RED   = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x39, 0x46)

# ── Dimensions (16:9) ──
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name='Calibri', italic=False, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.font.italic = italic
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, font_name='Calibri',
                   anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    """lines = [(text, size, color, bold, alignment, italic), ...]"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    for i, (text, size, color, bold, align, italic) in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.font.italic = italic
        p.alignment = align
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    # Adjust corner radius
    shape.adjustments[0] = 0.05
    return shape


def add_accent_line(slide, left, top, width, color=ACCENT_TEAL, height=Pt(3)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

                font_size=8, color=TEXT_MUTED)

circle1.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x25, 0x38)
circle1.line.fill.background()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Mental Health Burden PPTX directly using python-pptx."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

# ── Color Palette ──
BG_DARK      = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)
BG_SURFACE   = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x30, 0x44)
TEXT_WHITE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF1)
TEXT_SECOND   = RGBColor(0x88, 0x99, 0xAA)
TEXT_MUTED    = RGBColor(0x5A, 0x6F, 0x82)
ACCENT_TEAL  = RGBColor(0x48, 0xCA, 0xE4)
ACCENT_AMBER = RGBColor(0xF7, 0x7F, 0x00)
ACCENT_CORAL = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x6F, 0x51)
ACCENT_SAGE  = RGBColor(0x52, 0xB7, 0x88)
ACCENT_LAV   = RGBColor(0x9B, 0x8D, 0xC4)
ACCENT_RED   = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x39, 0x46)

# ── Dimensions (16:9) ──
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name='Calibri', italic=False, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.font.italic = italic
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, font_name='Calibri',
                   anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    """lines = [(text, size, color, bold, alignment, italic), ...]"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    for i, (text, size, color, bold, align, italic) in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.font.italic = italic
        p.alignment = align
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    # Adjust corner radius
    shape.adjustments[0] = 0.05
    return shape


def add_accent_line(slide, left, top, width, color=ACCENT_TEAL, height=Pt(3)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def add_footer(slide, slide_num):
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(7.0), Inches(6), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: Our World in Data / IHME GBD 2025",
                font_size=8, color=TEXT_MUTED)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(11.0), Inches(7.0), Inches(2), Inches(0.4),
                f"{slide_num} / 8",
                font_size=8, color=TEXT_MUTED, alignment=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)


def add_slide_number(slide, num, label):
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(3), Inches(0.3),
                f"{num:02d} — {label}",
                font_size=9, color=ACCENT_TEAL, bold=False)

circle1.fill.solid()
circle1.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x25, 0x38)
circle1.line.fill.background()

circle2 = s1.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(9), Inches(-1), Inches(5), Inches(5))
circle2.fill.solid()
circle2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x25, 0x38)
circle2.line.fill.background()

            "The Global Burden\nof Mental Illness",
            font_size=44, color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
            font_name='Calibri')

add_accent_line(s1, Inches(5.5), Inches(4.1), Inches(2.3), ACCENT_TEAL, Pt(3))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE 2: PREVALENCE CALLOUTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

add_slide_number(s2, 2, "Prevalence")
add_textbox(s2, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.8), Inches(9), Inches(0.8),

            font_size=30, color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=True, font_name='Calibri')

# Women card
card_w = Inches(5.2)
card_h = Inches(3.2)
women_card = add_rounded_rect(s2, Inches(1.0), Inches(1.9), card_w, card_h, BG_SURFACE, RGBColor(0x2A, 0x3F, 0x55))

add_textbox(s2, Inches(1.4), Inches(2.2), Inches(1), Inches(0.6),
            "♀", font_size=28, color=ACCENT_CORAL, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_textbox(s2, Inches(1.4), Inches(2.7), Inches(4), Inches(1.2),
            "1 in 3", font_size=52, color=ACCENT_CORAL, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(s2, Inches(1.4), Inches(3.8), Inches(4), Inches(0.8),
            "Women will experience major\ndepression in their lifetime",
            font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECOND, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Men card
men_card = add_rounded_rect(s2, Inches(6.8), Inches(1.9), card_w, card_h, BG_SURFACE, RGBColor(0x2A, 0x3F, 0x55))
add_accent_line(s2, Inches(6.8), Inches(1.9), card_w, ACCENT_TEAL, Pt(4))
add_textbox(s2, Inches(7.2), Inches(2.2), Inches(1), Inches(0.6),
            "♂", font_size=28, color=ACCENT_TEAL, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)
add_textbox(s2, Inches(7.2), Inches(2.7), Inches(4), Inches(1.2),
            "1 in 5", font_size=52, color=ACCENT_TEAL, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_textbox(s2, Inches(7.2), Inches(3.8), Inches(4), Inches(0.8),

            font_size=14, color=TEXT_SECOND, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_textbox(s2, Inches(1.0), Inches(5.5), Inches(11), Inches(1.2),

# Build bar chart using shapes

TEXT_WHITE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF1)
TEXT_SECOND   = RGBColor(0x88, 0x99, 0xAA)
TEXT_MUTED    = RGBColor(0x5A, 0x6F, 0x82)
ACCENT_TEAL  = RGBColor(0x48, 0xCA, 0xE4)
ACCENT_AMBER = RGBColor(0xF7, 0x7F, 0x00)
ACCENT_CORAL = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x6F, 0x51)
ACCENT_SAGE  = RGBColor(0x52, 0xB7, 0x88)
ACCENT_LAV   = RGBColor(0x9B, 0x8D, 0xC4)
ACCENT_RED   = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x39, 0x46)

# ── Dimensions (16:9) ──
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name='Calibri', italic=False, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.font.italic = italic
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, font_name='Calibri',
                   anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    """lines = [(text, size, color, bold, alignment, italic), ...]"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    for i, (text, size, color, bold, align, italic) in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.font.italic = italic
        p.alignment = align
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    # Adjust corner radius

    return shape

    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the Mental Health Burden PPTX directly using python-pptx."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LABEL_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

# ── Color Palette ──
BG_DARK      = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x1B, 0x2A)
BG_SURFACE   = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x30, 0x44)
TEXT_WHITE    = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xF1)
TEXT_SECOND   = RGBColor(0x88, 0x99, 0xAA)
TEXT_MUTED    = RGBColor(0x5A, 0x6F, 0x82)
ACCENT_TEAL  = RGBColor(0x48, 0xCA, 0xE4)
ACCENT_AMBER = RGBColor(0xF7, 0x7F, 0x00)
ACCENT_CORAL = RGBColor(0xE7, 0x6F, 0x51)
ACCENT_SAGE  = RGBColor(0x52, 0xB7, 0x88)
ACCENT_LAV   = RGBColor(0x9B, 0x8D, 0xC4)
ACCENT_RED   = RGBColor(0xE6, 0x39, 0x46)

# ── Dimensions (16:9) ──
SLIDE_W = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H
blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank


def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name='Calibri', italic=False, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.font.italic = italic
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_multi_text(slide, left, top, width, height, lines, font_name='Calibri',
                   anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    """lines = [(text, size, color, bold, alignment, italic), ...]"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.auto_size = None
    try:
        tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    except:
        pass
    for i, (text, size, color, bold, align, italic) in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.font.italic = italic
        p.alignment = align
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox


def add_rounded_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, border_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if border_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = border_color
        shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    # Adjust corner radius
    shape.adjustments[0] = 0.05
    return shape


def add_accent_line(slide, left, top, width, color=ACCENT_TEAL, height=Pt(3)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def add_footer(slide, slide_num):
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(7.0), Inches(6), Inches(0.4),
                "Source: Our World in Data / IHME GBD 2025",
                font_size=8, color=TEXT_MUTED)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(11.0), Inches(7.0), Inches(2), Inches(0.4),
                f"{slide_num} / 8",
                font_size=8, color=TEXT_MUTED, alignment=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)


def add_slide_number(slide, num, label):
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(3), Inches(0.3),
                f"{num:02d} — {label}",
                font_size=9, color=ACCENT_TEAL, bold=False)

# SLIDE 1: TITLE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

# Subtle gradient overlay circle (decorative)
circle1 = s1.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(-2), Inches(2), Inches(6), Inches(6))
circle1.fill.solid()
circle1.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x25, 0x38)
circle1.line.fill.background()

circle2 = s1.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(9), Inches(-1), Inches(5), Inches(5))
circle2.fill.solid()
circle2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x12, 0x25, 0x38)
circle2.line.fill.background()

add_textbox(s1, Inches(1.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(10.3), Inches(2.5),
            "The Global Burden\nof Mental Illness",
            font_size=44, color=TEXT_WHITE, bold=True, alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
